origine_fr: L'oiseau 鸟 et 合, écrit 人, 一 et 口, qui donnait le son mais se lit hé, plus gē. On le rangeait parmi les tourterelles. C'est le pigeon, la colombe.
origine_en: The bird 鸟 plus 合, written 人, 一 and 口, which gave the sound but is read hé, not gē. It was counted among the doves. It is the pigeon, the dove.

phrase.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shang yǒu hěn duō gēzi.
phrase.fr: Il y a beaucoup de pigeons sur la place.
phrase.en: There are lots of pigeons in the square.
